messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for route `/v1/chat/generate` across us-west-2. 5xx spike + fallback loop observed. Paging oncall: @Raj (oncall-ml) :rotating_light:

Raj (oncall-ml): Got it, picking this up. any initial signal? logs or recent deploys?

Alice (eng-runtime): We rolled a routing policy change ~10m ago to pin `model: redwood-instruct-2.1` for latency regression tests. That policy targeted `route: /v1/chat/*` — suspicious.

Bob (eng-sre): Seeing repeated fallbacks between variants: chat requests -> pinned instruct variant -> incompatibility -> fallback to gen-quant -> rejects -> retry in loop. Here's a sample error from the runtime: ```
ERROR: incompatible_variant: requested_interface=chat, model_interface=instruct
stack: serve/router.go:412
```

Carla (product): Wait, pinned an *instruct* model for a chat route? Why was that changed?

Alice (eng-runtime): The intent was to pin a low-latency variant for small prompts but I mistakenly used the `instruct` family alias in the policy. Config snippet: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  name: latency-test-2026
  route: "/v1/chat/*"
  pinned_model: "redwood-instruct-2.1"
  fallback: ["redwood-gen-2.0-quant", "redwood-instruct-2.0"]
```

Marta (customer-ops): We're already getting customer tickets — multiple customers reporting truncated or 500s from chat UX. Any estimate on affected % of traffic?

Bob (eng-sre): From telemetry: ~7% of chat traffic in us-west-2 hit the pinned policy and experienced failures; global error budget burn for chat spikes to ~3.8x normal. Customers impacted: 12 high-touch accounts (IDs listed in private ticket).

Raj (oncall-ml): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove the pin on `route:/v1/chat/*` (rollback policy) 2) add a safeguard rule so pinned model must match route interface 3) notify customers and open postmortem. Can someone approve rollback?

Alice (eng-runtime): I've opened a rollback PR to remove the policy pin: `#rel/rollback-latency-test` — I can merge and rollout now. Note: need a quick validation that we don't introduce capacity pressure.

Bob (eng-sre): I'll open a temporary rate limit on that policy so we don't surge. Also will watch the autoscale buffer for dedicated pools.

sre-bot: Deploy pipeline started: `deploy/rollback-latency-test` by Alice. CI checks passing. Estimated completion 45s.

Raj (oncall-ml): Merged and applied. Observability: error rate dropping in us-west-2 now. Watching.

(1m) Alice (eng-runtime): Error rate down to baseline, fallbacks stopped. No further 500 spikes.

Marta (customer-ops): Sent update to impacted customers: "We identified a routing policy that pinned an incompatible model variant to chat routes, causing retries. The policy has been rolled back. We're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem."

Carla (product): Please confirm root-cause: human-config entry (incorrect model family) + missing validation in policy engine to reject interface mismatches?

Alice (eng-runtime): Correct. Two gaps: 1) no model-interface validation when pinning by alias 2) policy change flow lacks a quickstage preflight that simulates compatibility matrix.

Raj (oncall-ml): Post-incident actions (short): 
- Add a server-side validation: pinned model must declare compatible interfaces for the route (chat/instruct/embed/gen).
- Add a CI preflight: test policy changes against a compatibility table.
- Ramp down permissions: require two approvers for policy changes that touch prod routing.
- Product: notify SLA owners and prepare customer follow-ups.

Bob (eng-sre): I'll create a compensating metric: `routing_pin_mismatch_count` + alert if >1/min.

Alice (eng-runtime): I'll file the RFC for validation and preflight. ETA for deploy: 1w for validation, 3w for full preflight harness.

Carla (product): Add a communications plan and a short KB entry for support to explain what a pin mismatch looks like.

Marta (customer-ops): Creating follow-up tickets for each impacted customer and tracking credits if needed.

Raj (oncall-ml): Handoff to day oncall in 20m — leaving notes in the incident doc. If recovery regresses reopen page.

incident-bot: Incident status: RESOLVED (mitigated) — rollback applied, error rates returned to normal. Incident ticket: #INC-2026-3492.

Alice (eng-runtime): Will add config lint to PR template to catch alias vs canonical names.

Bob (eng-sre): Thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: Alice + Raj. I'll schedule a quick blameless review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

(End thread)
